_README: MCP servers for BrainTrust backend. These extend Claude Code with external capabilities.
To activate: copy the mcpServers block you want into settings.json or settings.local.json.
For secrets (API keys, DB passwords), always put them in settings.local.json (gitignored).

filesystem._description: Gives Claude direct access to the backend directory tree.

postgresql._description: Direct PostgreSQL access. Claude can run SELECT queries, inspect schemas, check indexes, and debug data issues. NEVER runs DDL in prod.
postgresql._activation: Add to settings.local.json with your real DB URL

github._description: Access GitHub: read PRs, create issues, comment, check CI status for BrainTrust repo.

brave-search._description: Web search for Spring Boot docs, Java 21 APIs, Hibernate references, security advisories.
brave-search._install: No install — uses npx. Get key at https://brave.com/search/api/

sequential-thinking._description: Gives Claude a structured scratchpad for complex multi-step reasoning. Ideal for architecture decisions, debugging tricky async flows, or hexagonal refactors.

memory._description: Persistent knowledge graph across sessions. Claude can store domain facts (e.g., 'SubmissionId is a UUID value object') and recall them automatically.

docker._description: Control Docker containers. Claude can start/stop containers, read logs, inspect running services.
